description: This Java interface, named LoanApiConstants, defines a collection of string constants, lists, and annotations used for managing parameters, error codes, and transaction types related to loan APIs within the Fineract project. It serves as a centralized repository for API parameter names, error identifiers, and transaction types, and includes some external class references and collections.

classes.name: LoanApiConstants
classes.description: An interface that consolidates constants used across the loan API components, including parameter keys, error messages, and transaction type lists.
